title: measurement setup schema
description: The setup a measurement was performed with: the machine and the sitting — the experimental analogue of a job's compute. The technique is the workflow's application, not repeated here.

name.description: Identity of the instrument, as a cluster's fqdn identifies a cluster

description.description: Vendor, model, serial and whatever else describes the machine

session.description: The sitting during which the measurement was taken

directory.description: Where the instrument wrote its raw data

settings.description: Instrument parameters as set for this measurement

environment.description: Conditions during the measurement: temperature, pressure, atmosphere

registration.description: How the instrument frame maps onto the sample: frame, anchor, coordinates
